# ARGs with `line` `realizability`

*Lines of inquiry — A named line of the record's own argument, so that a line can be set aside as a whole and what depends on it can be found. Retracting a line is a status change on its members, never a deletion (ADR-032).*

**Resource-bounded realizability and individuation** — what a constrained system can realize, reach, tell apart and become under computational and physical bounds — compatibility against reachability, budgeted composition of processes, finding against navigating, restricted and enriched Yoneda profiles, isomorphism against persistence, with origami as the laboratory (ADR-073).

[CLAIM-615](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-615.md)'s admission case, a mechanism passed to an unrelated workshop and counted the same by its parts, meets the second clause of its own `defeated_if` if replacing the maintainer cuts transmission. [CLAIM-329](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-329.md)'s collective persists through the replacement of all its members because newcomers take the organization from the collective they join, so the path runs through the collective, not from old member to new. An unrelated garage likewise restores a car to the arrangement it finds in the car. So the path runs through the car, and the case is a continuation. The wording is the assistant's (Claude, in this session); adopting it is the owner's call. | Proposed |
